Market today:
The market mood is cautiously optimistic for tech, driven by strong demand signals for AI chips. The real driver is the continued AI boom, with big players like SpaceX and Microsoft pouring money into Nvidia GPUs, which directly benefits your concentrated chip holdings.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-29.29%) and SPAL (-17.02%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs with significant losses, and their listed "stops" are above current prices, indicating deep drawdowns. Trading on margin amplifies these drops, making them extra painful.

Watch:
Keep an eye on Treasury yields. While they backed off today, sustained higher yields could pressure growth stocks. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs for any signs of further decay.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged losses and be highly selective with any new entries, especially with "chasing" signals.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red, and margin amplifies losses. Re-evaluate their role in your portfolio.
